verifications.claim: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints will update to a new two-hour Sunday schedule starting September 6, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'starting in September'; R3: 'Beginning Sept. 6'; R5: 'starting Sept. 6'; R6: 'Beginning September 6'; all describe changes within the existing two-hour block
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the new schedule starts Sept. 6, 2026, within the two-hour block.

verifications.claim: The new schedule includes a 60-minute sacrament meeting.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: '60 minutes: Sacrament meeting'; R3: '60-minute sacrament meeting'; R5: 'Sacrament Meetings will continue to be one hour long'; R6: 'Sacrament meeting will continue to be 60 minutes'
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources explicitly state 60-minute sacrament meeting.

verifications.claim: The new schedule includes a 5-minute break.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: '5 minutes: Transition to classes'; R3: 'five-minute transition'; R5: '5-minute break between the three different meetings'

verifications.claim: The new schedule includes 25-minute classes for Sunday School, Relief Society, Priesthood, and Young Women every week rather than alternating.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: '25 minutes: Sunday school... 25 minutes: All-male priesthood quorums, Relief Society and Young Women classes... every week, rather than every other week'; R3: '25-minute Sunday School class... priesthood quorums, Relief Society and Young Women... each week'; R5: 'both Sunday School and... meetings every week, but for just 25 minutes each'; R6: 'Sunday School, Relief Society... will be held each week... 25 minutes'
verifications.reasoning: Exact match on durations, classes, and shift from alternating to every week.

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: '55 minutes: Children’s primary'; R3: 'Primary will continue every Sunday and will be 55 minutes'; R5: 'Primary... will now be 55 minutes long'; R6: 'Primary will continue every Sunday and will be 55 minutes'
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm 55 minutes for Primary.

verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No reference mentions classes beginning with prayer.

verifications.reasoning: Sequence and duration match exactly; clock times are illustrative of first hour.

verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.reasoning: Matches sequence and duration after sacrament; times illustrative.

verifications.reasoning: Matches sequence, duration, and audience; times illustrative.
